classification.difficultyReason: Locate the labelled temperature 28°C, select its unique observed dot and read its sales coordinate on the supplied grid. This directly applies taught coordinate reading.

content.prompt: The scatterplot shows the maximum temperature (in °C) and the number of ice creams sold by a shop on each of ten days. Each dot represents a day. How many ice creams were sold on the day when the maximum temperature was 28°C?

spec.description: Ten-point scatterplot with arrowed axes, grid, labelled ticks and axis titles. All dots are permanent givens.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal axis: temperature 16 to 32 degrees Celsius, grid step 1, labelled every 2. Vertical axis: ice creams sold 0 to 100, grid step 5, labelled every 10. Points (temperature, sales): (17,30), (19,35), (20,40), (22,45), (23,55), (25,50), (26,65), (28,75), (29,80), (31,90). Exactly one point lies at 28.
spec.answerVisibility: All points remain visible in the question edition.

answer.worked: Read the ice-creams coordinate of the dot at 28°C: 75.
